COMMON QUESTIONS

Quick answers before the call.

Transparent answers about our fixed-price sprints, code ownership, and Pune engineering process.

How quickly can Inrank launch our new website?+

Our Starter Sprint is deployed within 5 to 7 business days. Complex custom builds with e-commerce or dynamic CMS integrations take between 10 and 14 days. We work in dedicated, uninterrupted sprints to meet every launch deadline guaranteed.

Do we own the website source code and ad accounts?+

100% yes. From Day 1, you own every line of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, media assets, domain DNS, and advertising accounts. We never hold your digital assets hostage or use proprietary lock-in platforms.

How does Inrank help our business rank #1 on Google in Pune?+

We combine sub-second page performance (90+ Core Web Vitals) with Google Business Profile 3-Pack optimization, high-authority localized Pune citation building, and structured schema graphs. This dual-engine approach ensures Google and generative AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity) reward your site over slow competitor templates.

What is included in the ₹11,999 Starter Sprint?+

It includes up to 5 custom-engineered pages, responsive mobile architecture, 90+ Lighthouse speed score, complete technical on-page SEO tags, WhatsApp chat integration, contact form routing, and 30 days of post-launch engineering support.

Can you manage our Google Ads and Meta campaigns too?+

Yes. We build high-converting dedicated landing pages and manage paid ad campaigns with strict focus on ROAS and cost-per-qualified-lead. We filter out junk search terms and tune conversion funnels to maximize sales efficiency.

Where is Inrank located, and can we meet in person?+

Our primary engineering lab is in Baner, Pune, with client meeting desks at FC Road, Shivaji Nagar. We welcome in-person consultations or rapid Google Meet strategy calls at your convenience.
